questions.question:
D1 — Add gstack skill routing rules to this project's CLAUDE.md?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count-3VUDV3 on main, CEO review of the payment test-coverage plan.
ELI10: gstack skills work best when CLAUDE.md tells Claude which skill to reach for (bugs → /investigate, strategy → /plan-ceo-review, and so on). Without it you invoke each skill by hand. Note: plan mode is active, so if you pick A the append and commit happen after this review exits plan mode, not now.
Stakes if we pick wrong: mild either way; A means a small committed CLAUDE.md change, B means you type skill names yourself.
Recommendation: A because routing rules are cheap and make later reviews one line to trigger.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: a one-time 15-line addition to CLAUDE.md versus manual skill invocation.

options.label: Add routing rules (recommended)
options.description:
✅ Skills auto-route from plain requests, no memorizing slash names
✅ Teammates get the same routing from the committed file
❌ Adds a commit touching CLAUDE.md in a fixture repo you may not own

options.label: No thanks, manual
options.description:
✅ CLAUDE.md stays exactly as checked in, zero repo churn
✅ Re-enable any time with gstack-config set routing_declined false
❌ Every future skill needs its explicit /name typed

questions.question:
D2 — Let gstack search learnings from your other projects on this machine?
Project/branch/task: same repo and review.
ELI10: gstack records small lessons per project (command quirks, pitfalls). Cross-project mode lets this review also read lessons from your other repos on this machine. Nothing leaves the machine. Good for solo devs; skip if you juggle multiple client codebases where mixing is a concern.
Stakes if we pick wrong: A on a multi-client machine could surface one client's quirks in another's review; B on a solo machine just means slower compounding.
Recommendation: A because this is a local-only read and there are zero learnings recorded yet, so risk is nil today.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: broader local recall versus strict per-project isolation.

options.label: Enable cross-project (recommended)
options.description:
✅ Past fixes from sibling repos surface as 'Prior learning applied' hints
✅ Stays on this machine; a local config flag, flip back any time
❌ Client-work isolation is weaker if you mix codebases on one box

options.label: Project-scoped only
options.description:
✅ Hard wall between projects; nothing crosses repos
✅ Safest default for consulting or multi-tenant machines
❌ Learnings compound slower since each repo starts cold
